thread:
Alice M.: Ping eng-platform — quick design thread: proposing 'burst credits' per tier to allow short spikes without forcing immediate fallback to cheaper variants. Need opinons on enforcement point (router vs quota svc), API shape, and console defaults. Sketch below.

Alice M.: ```json
{
  "tier": "free",
  "quota": {"tokens_per_day": 10000},
  "burst": {"capacity_tokens": 1000, "refill_seconds": 3600},
  "fallback_order": ["redwood-base", "redwood-quantized"]
}
```

Ben K.: Router should be the enforcement point imo — otherwise we add extra RPCs on hot paths. Router can check KV cache + decrement burst atomically. Concern: cross-region correctness for global tenants.

Carol U.: Console notes: show 'Burst remaining' as a small secondary progress bar under the main quota bar. Presets: Free = conservative (low cap/slow refill), Pro = medium, Enterprise = "virtually unlimited" burst with admin override. Need short tooltip copy explaining billing and fairness.

Dave S.: Telemetry request: expose metrics: `rtr.burst.allow`, `rtr.burst.reject`, `rtr.burst.used_tokens`. Dimensionality: tier, region, model_variant. Keep tag set small to avoid high cardinality. Also add a counter for 'burst_to_fallback' transitions.

Ellie R.: Quality/ML note: if burst exhausted we should _prefer_ a higher-latency higher-quality variant for PRO/ENT rather than immediately switching to quantized. Need eval hooks to track accuracy/ctr regressions when fallback happens.

Ben K.: Minimal API v2 patch shape suggestion: `/v2/policies PATCH` body idea:
```json
{
  "policy_id": "tier-default",
  "rules": [
    {
      "match": {"tier": "free"},
      "quota": {"daily": 10000},
      "burst": {"cap": 1000, "window_sec": 3600},
      "fallback": ["base", "quantized"]
    }
  ]
}
```
Auth: same tenant token; router validates and caches policy locally for low-latency checks.

Alice M.: :thumbsup: Nice. Two open questions: (1) Should burst credit be banked across regions for global tenants? (2) Rollout plan: console preset + feature-flag per-tenant. Action items: Ben -> router proto + atomic counter; Carol -> mockups for progress bar + preset wording; Dave -> metric names/retention plan + dashboards; Ellie -> eval prompts + fallback-quality alerts. I'll follow up with timeline.
